canonical_project: Unified Data Storage and Processing Center of E-Government (Zangiata)
owner: Government of Uzbekistan (E-Government system); equipment by Huawei
notes: Official president.uz: center built in Zangiata District, Tashkent Region, launched 27 August 2022 as part of Digital Uzbekistan 2030; 20 PB capacity, 580 servers, diesel generators totalling 5 MW, certified Tier III by Uptime Institute; serves as the heart of e-government data storage/processing.
